(1) The global section functor
Γ : ModSX →ModS X(X)
is exact and establishes an equivalence of categories between the category of sheaves of right
SX-modules and the category of right modules over the global sections SX(X) of SX.
(2) If F ∈ModS X locally has ﬁnite resolutions by ﬁnitely generated free SX-modules, then
Γ(X, F) has a ﬁnite resolution by ﬁnitely generated projective modules.
(3) The derived category of perfect complexes of sheaves DPerf(ModSX) is equivalent to the
derived category of perfect complexes of modules DPerf(ModS X(X)).
